ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Choose the correct herbivore from the list below.
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “FOOD WEB.” It shows producers/plants including Grass and Trees, and animals labeled Mouse, Rabbit, Deer, Cricket, Frog, Snake, Hawk, Mountain lion, and King cobra. In the diagram, an arrow goes from Grass upward to Mouse, indicating that energy/food flows from the grass to the mouse. Reasoning: The question asks which animal is the herbivore. A herbivore is an animal that eats plants or producers. Since the food web shows Mouse receiving food/energy from Grass, the mouse is the herbivore.
